job: Offer to add the product to the person's own agent or coding tool.
purpose: A pill button with a small stack of overlapping tiles for the tools it works with (Claude, Cursor and so on). The tiles spread on hover. It sits in an agent top row or a page head as the way out to MCP or skill setup.
useWhen: The product can run inside the person's own agent and you want a visible entry to setup.
An agent page needs a secondary action next to history or settings.

avoidWhen.when: The action is a plain command in the page.
Setup is a set of steps with a command to copy.

variants.useWhen: A tile coloured with the info tone.
A tile in the neutral fill.
A tile in the violet fill, to tell stacked tools apart.

parts.role: One tool tile with an icon.
